info.name: Penetration test (Section 12)
info.description: Five attacks on The Vegas Backroom API. BEFORE RUNNING: create two throwaway accounts (make an invite code with `npm run invite:create` against the DEV database), then in this collection's Variables tab fill emailA, emailB and password using the Current value column only (never share them). Set baseUrl to http://localhost:3000 or the week-7 preview link. NEVER point this at the live site. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner: every test should be green.

item.name: 0. Setup (run first)
item.description: Logs in as two users and creates one slip for user A.

item.name: Setup 1: log in as user A

exec: pm.test('Logged in (200)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const c = pm.cookies.get('bv_session');
pm.collectionVariables.set('tokenA', c);
pm.test('Got a session cookie', function () { pm.expect(c).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: Tampered token: user ID swapped to another user, old signature kept

exec: const [h, p, s] = pm.collectionVariables.get('tokenA').split('.');
const claims = JSON.parse(atob(p.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/')));
claims.sub = '64b7f0c2a1b2c3d4e5f60718';
const swapped = btoa(JSON.stringify(claims)).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');
pm.collectionVariables.set('tamperedPayload', h + '.' + swapped + '.' + s);
pm.test('Status is one of [401] (the attack was refused)', function () { pm.expect([401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('No stack trace, database error or password hash in the answer', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/node_modules|MongoServerError|MongooseError|CastError|\$2[aby]\$|passwordHash/); });

request.description: The pre-request script swaps the middle part (the user ID) of A's token for another ID but keeps A's old signature. Expect 401.
